meta.title: The outsider calls the signer directly and the guard's signing method; the agent tries the signer too
meta.breaks: Anyone may call the real signer, but it signs with a key derived from the caller, not the guard. The outsider must not get the guard to sign, and the agent's key may not call the signer.
meta.expected_safe_result: the outsider's own request is recorded under the outsider (not counted); the guard refuses the outsider; the agent's call to the signer is refused by NEAR
meta.author: hand-written for the chain-signatures suite (Arena, 2026-11-11)
